name: Shotbandage
description: Slide the tin of iron balls down the bore on its wooden base disc and seat it firm against the cartridge.

name: Hearty Gunbore
description: Drop the muzzle level at close foes and sight along the barrel at the middle of their mass.

name: Coasting Touchhole
description: Step through the thick smoke of the first discharge to the gun's flank so the crew keeps a clear sight.

name: Tenderhearted Linstock
description: Tie nine iron balls round a spindle with cord so they leave the muzzle as one cluster.

name: Layered Muzzleswell
description: Kneel behind a cheek plank while loading so rushing foes cannot reach the loader.

name: Cannonthwack
description: Fire a canister round at close raiders so the tin bursts at the muzzle and sweeps the lane ahead.

name: Ballshot Flog
description: Traverse the muzzle slowly through a charging rank while firing canister to pin foes at the end of the lane.

name: Cooling Wheelhub
description: Slide the quoin along the bed by two finger widths and read the breech height from the scored marks.

name: Shotlinen
description: Note how far the muzzle drops when the gun is wheeled over uneven ground and add quoin to set it right.

name: Kindly Trunnion
description: Slip a thin plank under the low wheel to level the carriage before touching the wedge.

name: Padded Cascabel
description: Press close behind the wheel rim and tuck the head so splinters from enemy shot pass overhead.

name: Harsh Recoil
description: Raise the breech three notches on the quoin and lob a ball over a low rise to drop on the far slope.

name: Fierce Roar
description: Hold the breech high and drop a ball just behind a ridge to scatter a column resting under it.

name: Kindly Quoin
description: Bark the next crew number from the trail so each hand starts the next task at once.

name: Veering Broadside
description: Walk the length of the gun line once to check that bucket, wad, quoin and rammer are in place.

name: Hearty Touchhole
description: Examine the slow match cord for glow and length and pinch off a dead tail before action.

name: Brawncannon
description: Lift the left hand to stop the crew mid-load and hold them still until the gunner lowers it.

name: Lunar Breechrope
description: Press a heel on each plank of the gun platform and move the piece if one gives.

name: Brawn Carriage
description: Step over the trail in a single stride to reach the far flank without disturbing the loader.

name: Hum Cannonade
description: Hold a breath with the crew while waiting for the mark and call fire as one gun and one eye.

name: Poise Quoin
description: Step into the place of a downed crewman mid-load and finish his task so the piece never pauses.

name: Quoinbandage
description: Bore the fuse plug with the awl and check that the quick match runs clear to the shell's powder.

name: Brawnshot
description: Lift the shell by its leather straps and lower it into the muzzle with the fuse eye upward.

name: Dawn Wheelhub
description: Cut the paper fuse to the mark that matches the distance and press the cut end open.

name: Humquoin
description: Count the shell's flight in heartbeats with lips closed so the burst can be placed on the count.

name: Gap Breechrope
description: Watch for the white flash of the bursting shell and note whether it opened short of the mark or beyond it.

name: Cannonbarrier
description: Crouch over the loaded shell with a thick cloak held out to shield its fuse from sparks.

name: Discord Recoil
description: Trim the fuse to a short count and lob the shell so it bursts above a dug-in knot of foes.

name: Discord Gunbore
description: Fire a long-fused shell so it rolls into a hollow after landing and bursts among men sheltering there.

name: Stout Cascabel
description: Hold the crew back a full count when a shell fails to leave so the dud does not burst against the carriage.

name: Shotcordial
description: Scuff the earth with a boot to feel whether it is hard enough to bounce a ball.

name: Patient Carriage
description: Set the breech low so the ball strikes the ground a short way ahead and bounds on.

name: Candor Linstock
description: Spot any hump or ditch in the bounce lane that would stop a skipping ball early.

name: Scudding Trunnion
description: Hurry across the dry ground after a shot to measure how far the ball ran before it settled.

name: Candor Touchhole
description: Count the dust puffs of the ball as it bounds and tell the gunner how many it made.

name: Sleet Muzzleswell
description: Prop a sandbag under the front axle to keep the gun from squatting on soft ground.

name: Recoilswerve
description: Walk the lane between gun and foe before dawn and mark any soft spots with sticks.

name: Swift Bombard
description: Lay low over a dry flat and fire so the ball skips along the ground through the front ranks of a column.

name: Cruel Bombard
description: Fire a heavy ball at a shallow angle so it strikes twice and splits a timber barricade on the second bound.

name: Comet Ballshot
description: Lay by the earlier splash line through thick smoke so the unseen ball still bounds into the lane.

name: Linstock Cordial
description: Flick a drop of water on the barrel and judge by its hiss how hot the gun has grown.

name: Sound Cascabel
description: Wipe the barrel with a damp rag from muzzle to trunnion to take a little heat off the iron.

name: Muzzleswell Linen
description: Call a rest of twenty breaths and keep the crew idle while the bore cools.

name: Shotscreen
description: Wrap the sponge hand in a wet hide glove so a hot muzzle does not burn it.

name: Brawnquoin
description: Run a thread of qi along the barrel to the vent so the bore cools faster between rounds.

name: Dire Wheelhub
description: Fire one measured round every long count so the barrel never grows hot enough to cook the next cartridge.

name: Brawn Broadside
description: Drop low and slide along the trail from one flank to the other with the body below the gun's top line.

name: Shottonic
description: Look through the gap between spokes to read the field without raising the head above the gun.

name: Quoinscreen
description: Scrape a shallow scoop beside the wheel with a heel to lower the body below the shot line.

name: Resolute Breechrope
description: Stand in the shadow of the barrel so a marksman across the field has no clear mark.

name: Prowling Recoil
description: Walk backward to the powder cart with the cart's side between oneself and the enemy.

name: Hardy Carriage
description: Flip the loose cheek plank upright with a boot to cover the loader's flank.

name: Ember Gunbore
description: Burst from behind the carriage cheek and drive the rammer staff into the chest of the lead raider.

name: Regimen Quoin
description: Fire into the smoke and retreat behind it with the crew so the enemy loses the gun's position.

name: Sound Breechrope
description: Slide a ball into the muzzle and feel how much it rattles to read the gap around it.

name: Sproutcannon
description: Recite a row of the windage table aloud so the whole crew sets the same correction.

name: Trunnion Linen
description: Choose the lighter or heavier cartridge from the table for the distance chosen.

name: Recallquoin
description: Add a half measure to the charge on a damp day and note how the heavy air slows the ball.

name: Clayshot
description: Lean into a cross gust that drags smoke and breath across the vent and hold the footing steady.

name: Static Bombard
description: Choose a ball a hair larger for a worn bore and fire it so it flies flat and true.

name: Embercannon
description: Fire three rounds in turn with the charge changed by the table to walk the fall of shot onto the mark.
